Activate 1 (manipulate, polymorph)

This small silvery box is covered in fine circuitry. When you Activate the box by opening it, it reveals a bright blue light and engulfs you in crackling energy that expands to form an enormous hardlight robot, with you in a central cockpit. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the effect or are reduced to 0 Hit Points. The robot is a battle form that grants you the following statistics and abilities.

  • AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

  • 25 temporary Hit Points

  • Speed 40 feet, fly Speed 70 feet

  • Darkvision

  • The following unarmed attacks, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them, your attack modifier is +31, and you use the listed damage. Both attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead;

  • Melee 1 stellar blade (reach 15 feet), Damage 3d12+15 slashing;

  • Ranged 1 galactic beam (range increment 120 feet), Damage 6d6+6 force.

  • Athletics modifier of +33, unless your own is higher.
